paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.25% on average, with DAX strongest (+1.13%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.43%). Brent crude changed -0.17% to 104.1. Gold changed +1.30% to 4,211.0. Bitcoin changed +1.23% to 82,683.1562. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.253%, a relative move of +0.42%. Among the firms tracked, Apollo (+4.12%) and KKR (+3.21%) moved the most.
